section_summary.extract_value: This section presents construct validity evidence for the Body Appreciation Scale (BAS), reporting correlations between BAS scores and various psychological and physical measures. The BAS showed positive correlations with appearance evaluation and self-esteem, and negative correlations with beauty internalization, dieting, weight-related teasing, BMI, and eating disorder symptoms, supporting the validity of the instrument.
